comment: FACILITY ALERT LEVEL tunables (living-world pillar 3). Mirrors defaultAlertConfig() in app/alert.cpp — a missing/broken file falls back to those defaults. Heat economy: stimuli add heat (with per-stimulus level floors); thresholds[] map heat to levels 1-4 (rise instant); hiding (quiet + unseen) for decayDelay seconds drains heat at decayPerSec[level] until the level steps back down through the downFrac hysteresis band.
